Sora job routes exist (/v1/ai/video/*, ZDR-gated, 20 s and 4-variant limits) but no gateway or SPA route, chat tool, ArtifactKind::Video or spend metering was found, there is no Gemini provider in inference-core, and integration-corev2 has no meeting-transcript connector.
reuse: model-gateway /v1/ai/speech and zdr_posture::decide_content_route for governed transcription
Data Plane embedding-engine media_consumer subjects and the media-embedder service (consumer side is built; emit the existing segment events with transcript filled)

constraints: Data Plane owns transcript documents and segment events while Model Plane owns inference, so the Data Plane job must call Model Plane speech with the delegated bearer rather than embed a provider. Media embedding is local-only (no egress, ZDR-safe by construction), but a transcript document is a durable mutation and must be refused for ZDR orgs; video generation is already rejected for unattested ZDR in inference-core. Meeting transcripts are fetched by Ingestion Plane integration-corev2 under Graph transcript scopes (admin consent), recording laws and retention rules apply, and the Channel Plane meeting-intelligence doc is future-only. Data Plane documents are UTF-8 text up to 5 MiB, so the media itself is not stored as a document.
approachAdjustment: Replace 'first check imports-core' with the finding: imports-core has no media path, and Data Plane's consumer already exists without a producer. Build the producer (ffmpeg segmentation, silence chunking under the speech limit, per-chunk transcription) as a Data Plane orchestrator job, create the transcript document first, then emit the existing dataplane.audio_segments.created and video_segments.created events with transcript text and start_ms/end_ms so retrieval cites timestamps. For video_generate, estimate and meter cost first (none found on the route), add a video artifact kind, then wrap the job as an async tool behind an approval card. Treat meetings, uploads, video generation and video understanding as four separate items.
effortNote: Raised from L as a combined item: the segment producer, Teams/Zoom transcript connectors, video cost metering and a Gemini provider are all missing; uploads-to-transcripts alone is M and video_generate alone is M.
verdictReason: Not unknown: the code shows what exists (speech API, media-embedding consumer, Sora routes) and what is missing (producer, connectors, tool, metering, Gemini); the item's claim of Sora cost metering and its imports-core check are wrong or obsolete.

exactGap: No cross-chat library exists: the Reports and Findings pages read the local transcript cache and a title regex (ChatUtilityPage), the artifact panel only exports Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF, and artifacts persist as per-thread message metadata in session-core. The document-backed pieces exist but are unwired: POST /api/v1/chat/documents and /api/v1/knowledge/documents create Data Plane documents (private by default for end users), the Knowledge page lists them and ShareDialog shares them through resource_grants, while execution-core's workspace_promote.rs is a ZDR-guarded promotion primitive with no caller. documents-api-go lists only by org, type and viewer visibility, so there is no origin-thread or source filter, and its documents are UTF-8 text up to 5 MiB, so binary artifacts cannot be stored there.

constraints: Data Plane v2 owns documents and Control Plane owns grants, so 'publish' must stay 'save as document then share through resource_grants', never a parallel store or public link by default. The current chat-document upload route hard-codes zdr_classification 'internal' and shows no ZDR refusal, so a save action must refuse for ZDR sessions (ZDR must propagate) and keep end-user documents private. Space or org visibility must never be widened by the save; org-wide visibility needs an admin and is not the default.
approachAdjustment: Implement 'Save as document' in the gateway on the existing knowledge document create (not workspace_promote.rs, which is sandbox-only and has no caller), with a dedicated type value such as chat_artifact plus source and metadata carrying thread id, artifact id and version, so the existing type filter drives the library without a Data Plane schema change; add a source or metadata filter only if needed. Scope the first cut to text artifacts (document, code, html); binary kinds (spreadsheet, file, image, delivered as data URIs) need the blob store from F-t3-017. Surface the library as a filtered view inside the Knowledge page rather than a new store.
effortNote: Unchanged for text artifacts; L if binary artifacts are included, because documents-api accepts text only and a blob store is a prerequisite.
verdictReason: Status is partial rather than absent (document create, listing and sharing exist); the approach holds but must add the text-only limit, the ZDR gate on the save route and the type-based filter.

exactGap: No demonstration recorder or recording-to-skill path exists in Quarry or Model Plane code, but substrate does: human takeover actions arrive over the live-view websocket and run through the same execute_ws_action path as agent actions, which appends step receipts with actor id (skipped under ZDR), and a RUN_COMPLETED learning loop writes transcript-derived skills into session-core. That loop persists skills with enabled=true and origin background_review and has no proposal or review state, and a Quarry plan (section 42, greenfield) already describes recording human takeover and compiling deterministic browser procedures with candidate/shadow/active/quarantined rollout.

constraints: Quarry owns recording, procedure compilation and execution; the Model proposes browser actions and Quarry executes or rejects them, so a taught skill should reference a Quarry procedure id and parameters and replay through Quarry with per-step confirmation, not re-drive the browser from skill prose. Under ZDR Quarry writes no receipts or checkpoints, so recording must be refused for ZDR sessions. Receipts store the full AgentAction (typed text included) and no redaction of typed text was found, so credentials a human types in takeover would be retained unless the recorder redacts or excludes secret fields first. Skills must pass the proposal path of F-t3-007 (owner-scoped, reviewed) because the current learning loop auto-enables skills.
approachAdjustment: Re-anchor the item on Quarry's planned section 42 (recorded browser procedure and compiler) rather than a new Model Plane recorder: Quarry records and compiles a candidate procedure from takeover receipts, Model Plane drafts the parameterised description and routes it through the F-t3-007 proposal path, and replay runs under Quarry rollout states with confirmation. Human takeover actions are coordinate-based (ClickPoint) and Type with selectors, so distillation must resolve them to semantic locators from observations. Add secret-field redaction as a hard precondition.
effortNote: Raised from L: Quarry's procedure compiler is greenfield with rollout states, and the recorder, redaction, review UI and skill wrapper all sit on top of F-t3-008, F-t3-026 and F-t3-007.
verdictReason: Planned, not partial: the feature itself is docs-only but the substrate and an existing Quarry plan change where it should be built, and two safety preconditions (ZDR, typed-text redaction) are missing from the item.
